name: droidos
description: DroidOS – CasaOS-inspired Android home server platform for Termux

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=apps/server & npm run dev --workspace=apps/dashboard
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/server && npm run build --workspace=apps/dashboard
scripts.clean: rimraf apps/*/dist apps/*/node_modules packages/*/dist packages/*/node_modules node_modules
